decisions.title: Keep Studio platform and business project context separated
decisions.decision: Studio context lives under runtime/global; formal project context lives under runtime/projects/<project_id>.

decisions.title: Preserve examples project memory as compatibility evidence
decisions.decision: examples/jinhu-smart-park/runtime-memory remains available, while runtime/projects/jinhu-smart-park is the formal project memory.

decisions.title: Autopilot remains single-step and approval-gated
decisions.decision: Autopilot Runner may execute only safe local repository actions; managed project, HIGH risk, deploy, production, and secret-value work remains proposal-only.

decisions.title: Treat feature/engineering-project-delivery-runtime as the active Jinhu development line
decisions.decision: Do not push jinhu-smart-park directly to main during takeover. Continue managed-project development on the active feature branch until an explicit merge or integration step is prepared.

decisions.title: Refresh both business-repo runtime memory and Agent Studio imported project memory before takeover
decisions.decision: Before resuming development, rebuild ops/agent-orchestrator/runtime in jinhu-smart-park, then re-import that memory into examples/jinhu-smart-park/runtime-memory and runtime/projects/jinhu-smart-park.

decisions.title: Do not resume multi-agent orchestration until agent worktrees are resynced
decisions.decision: The main managed-project worktree is current, but agent-1 through agent-5 worktrees lag the active feature branch. Use single-worktree development for now and resync or recreate agent worktrees before dispatching orchestrated runs.

decisions.title: Resolve managed-project execution into the target repository before any write decision
decisions.decision: Autopilot and Console execution must first resolve the target project repo path, branch, project context, and runtime-memory location. Governance then decides whether execution stays proposal-only or can proceed, but branch creation and write planning must never default back into the Studio repository for managed-project work.

decisions.title: Treat conventional business applications as the primary product surface
decisions.decision: The group cockpit is a cross-system command and observation entry. Strategy, HR, Finance, Growth and Sales, Manufacturing ERP, and Smart Park remain independent conventional business applications with their own endpoints, personas, permissions, data, forms, records, approvals, work queues, reports, and workflows.

decisions.title: Use one intelligent runtime beneath every business application
decisions.decision: All applications share the existing Kernel, Scheduler, Workflow, Skill, Agent, online Runner, Runtime Adapter, Runtime Memory, Approval, Audit, and Outbox foundations. Business applications must not create duplicate orchestration stacks.

decisions.title: Keep business records authoritative over Agent tasks
decisions.decision: A Goal or Agent Task may plan, analyse, assign, or advance a business record, but it cannot replace that record. Runtime Memory stores scoped execution knowledge and recovery state, not the authoritative ERP, CRM, HR, finance, manufacturing, or park transaction.

decisions.title: Deploy Studio only through the reviewed Office 204 release workflow
decisions.decision: Agents and business Runners may not invoke arbitrary deployment commands. An explicitly authorized Studio release may deploy main only through the guarded GitHub Actions to Aliyun jump host to Office 204 workflow, with validation, commit pinning, health checks, and no interactive production shell.

decisions.title: Use a governed multi-provider bakeoff for high-fidelity character reconstruction
decisions.decision: Generate geometry-only candidates with Meshy-6 and Tripo v3.1 before purchasing textures, score candidates against the locked eight-view references, then complete proportions, branding, topology, materials and print preparation in a DCC closure stage. No provider output is accepted directly as the printable master.

decisions.title: Treat production 3D modeling as an independent governed domain
decisions.decision: Keep high-fidelity reconstruction, curved-surface refinement, detail conformance, topology QA and print-release evidence reusable outside the video workflow. Delegate execution to the existing Skill Router and Blender adapter instead of creating duplicate orchestration primitives.

decisions.title: Use Meshy text-to-3D only as an assembly semantics probe
decisions.decision: The real Meshy-6 text candidate improved visible seams but failed identity, silhouette, materials and authorable part hierarchy. Keep V15 as the protected baseline; translate prompt semantics into explicit part masks and local feature-aware retopology, and require inverse-render fidelity plus assembly inspection before promotion.

decisions.title: Use gauge-driven semantic geometry instead of prompt-only reconstruction
decisions.decision: Keep V15 immutable and calibrate named semantic parts with millimeter datums, owner-reviewable front pixel probes, primitive and Bezier profiles, and explicit interface tolerances. AI-generated hidden views remain non-metric depth priors; missing depth must HOLD local patch execution rather than guess geometry or apply global smoothing.

decisions.title: Transfer V15 depth as provisional gauge evidence
decisions.decision: Raycast authoritative front X/Z gauges through an immutable, hash-protected V15 Blender baseline and store the resulting Y extents only as provisional evidence. Use the transfer to expose fused provider geometry and select a semantic part for reconstruction; never treat V15 depth as owner-approved metric truth or overwrite the master.
